33.steps:
1. Put SonicWALL1 behind a NAT device. 
  2. Configure a secondary WAN interface on X2 port of SonicWALL2. 
  3. Configure matching IKEv1 VPN policies on SonicWALL1 and SonicWALL2. 
  4. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL1, enter X1 IP address of a peer in the Primary IPSec Gateway field and X2 IP address of the peer in the Secondary IPSec Gateway address field. Enable DPD on SonicWALL1. 
  5. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL12, enter 0.0.0.0 in the Primary IPSec Gateway field. 
  6. Disconnect the cable on the primary WAN of SonicWALL2. 
  7. Start a continuous ping from PC1 to PC2. Make sure that SonicWALL1 starts negotiation with primary gateway and fails after five retries. Then SonicWALL1 creates IKE SA and IPsec SA with the secondary gateway. 
  8. On the SonicWALL2, bring X1 interface up (plug-in the cable to the X1 interface). Verify traffic is not disrupted to the destination gateway and it still uses tunnel to the secondary gateway. 
  9. Let IKE SA lifetime expire.
33.initial: PC1--X0 SonicWALL1 X1--NAT device-- X1,X2 SonicWALL2 X0-- PC2
33.title: Remote site is behind a NAT device. Primary gateway becomes available after SA lifetime expiry.
33.result:
SonicWALL1 starts IKE negotiation to the primary gateway and establishes IKE SA with primary gateway. 
  SonicWALL1 deletes IPSec tunnels to secondary gateway. 
  Traffic flows to the destination network using the primary gateway.

7.steps:
1. Configure a secondary WAN interface on X2 port of SonicWALL2. 
  2. Configure matching IKEv1 VPN policies on SonicWALL1 and SonicWALL2. 
  3. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL1, enter FQDN that is associated with X1 IP address of a peer in the Primary IPSec Gateway field and X2 IP address of the peer in the Secondary IPSec Gateway address field. Enable DPD on SonicWALL1.

7.initial: PC1 --- X0 SonicWALL1 X1 --- X1,X2 SonicWALL2 X0 --- PC2
7.title: Remote firewall is using FQDN as a primary Gateway, IP Address as a secondary Gateway
7.result:
The initial tunnel is established between the boxes. FQDN address is used as IPSec Gateway. IP address that is resolved from the Domain Name is shown as Gateway in the Currently active tunnels section on the VPN > Settings page on SonicWALL1. When the cable on the default WAN of SonicWALL2 is disconnected, the DPD on SonicWALL1 detects a dead peer and deletes the tunnel. 
  Ping from PC1 initiates negotiation on SonicWALL1. It uses primary IPSec GW first. When the first negotiation is aborted due to timeout, the new IKE negotiation starts and uses secondary IPSec GW. Negotiation completes. The secondary WAN IP address of SonicWALL2 is shown as Gateway in the Currently active tunnels section on the VPN > Settings page on SonicWALL1.

26.steps:
1. Configure a secondary WAN interface on X2 port of SonicWALL2. 
  2. Configure matching IKEv1 VPN policies on SonicWALL1 and SonicWALL2. 
  3. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL1, enter X1 IP address of a peer in the Primary IPSec Gateway field and X2 IP address of the peer in the Secondary IPSec Gateway address field. Enable Keep Alive in the policy. Enable DPD on SonicWALL1. 
  4. In a VPN policy on SonicWALL12, enter 0.0.0.0 in the Primary IPSec Gateway field. 
  5. When the tunnel is established, disconnect the cable on the primary WAN of SonicWALL2. 
  6. Remote site detects the primary gateway unreachable and starts IKE negotiation with primary gateway again. This fails after 5 retries. Remote site negotiate IKE tunnel with secondary gateway. This negotiation is successful. 
  7. On the SonicWALL2, bring X1 interface up (plug-in the cable to the X1 interface). 
  8. Let IKE SA lifetime expire.

2.initial: PC1 --- X0 SonicWALL1 X1 --- X1,X2 SonicWALL2 X0 --- PC2
2.title: Continuous Ping From a Remote Firewall
2.result:
The initial tunnel is established using the primaty gateway. 
  After the cable on the primary WAN of SonicWALL2 has been disconnected, the ping from PC1 gets dropped. SonicWALL1 sends a configured number of DPD requests before the existing tunnel gets deleted. 
  A new IKE negotiation is initiated by ping. It uses the primary IPSec gateway first. This negotiation fails after 3 retries. A new IKE negotiation starts and uses the secondary IPSec Gateway address. The new tunnel is established. 
  FTP, Telnet, Ping, and HTTP services work through the new tunnel.
